subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

a. Some printers are laser.

b. Some printers are inkjet.

c. No inkjet is a laser.

**Conclusions:**

i. Some inkjet are laser.

ii. Some laser are inkjet.

iii. Some laser are not inkjet.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d15bdf172df582186c081fd669dae41b76e8e6f3594b7765b3a91b8df381ad66.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some inkjet are laser → Does not follow (As no inkjet is a laser. As direct relation is given between inject and laser, therefore it is true.)

II. Some laser are inkjet → Does not follow (As no inkjet is a laser. As direct relation is given between inject and laser, therefore it is true.)

III. Some laser are not inkjet → Follow (As no inkjet is a laser. As direct relation is given between inject and laser thus can be proved, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Only (iii) follows.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
